svg.aria-label: How AI builds the app: an idea goes to the backlog, the main Claude chat plans the batch, helpers do the jobs starting with the cheapest, the main chat reviews and integrates, quality checks must pass, then a backup and a deploy. Personal data only ever goes to the local models, and every job is logged.
